name: Lyo.Story
tagline: Play-graph contracts for interactive stories and quests: nodes, choices, named actions, trigger/condition/response rules, optional presentation, and `IStoryStore`.
description: Domain contracts for a quest-style play graph. The system of record is nodes, choices, named actions, and trigger/condition/response reactions. Presentation (text, cutscene, or none) is optional on a node. Scenes are optional groups, not the play cursor. Conditions persist as Lyo.Query `WhereClause` trees (`var.*` / `chose.*` / `visited.*` field prefixes) and are evaluated by `StoryPlayEngine` against the play bag — not `WhereClauseEvaluator`. Consequence tracking is the play log (`CausedByEventId`), not an authoring table. Persistence facade is `IStoryStore`.
features: **Play graph.** `Story` with nodes, optional scenes, declared variables, named actions, choices, and ambient reactions.
**Builders.** `StoryBuilder` with `WhenAll` / `WhenOneOf` and `.Do` response lists. `StorySamples.TheHeist()` is the canonical sample.
**Engine.** `StoryPlayEngine` is pure: start, available moves, take choice, advance, get causes. No EF.
**Query conditions.** Reuses `WhereClause` / `GroupClause` (And = All, Or = OneOf). Story sugar (`Flag`, `Chose`, `Visited`) emits those nodes.

**Tenancy.** `Story.TenantId` and `Story.GameKey` scope a graph to a tenant and a game. `IStoryStore.ListStoriesAsync(tenantId, gameKey)` lists headers ordered by title; a null tenant lists only stories with no tenant. Slugs stay globally unique.

examples.title: Author a graph
examples.code:
var story = StoryBuilder.New("The Heist")
    .Slug("the-heist")
    .Variable("alarm", StoryVariableType.Boolean, false)
    .StartNode("vault_door", n => n
        .Choice("smash", c => c.Do(d => d.Set("alarm", true).GoesTo("guards"))))
    .Node("guards", n => n.Ending())
    .Build();

sections.title: What is deliberately not here
items: Playing cutscene media. Store `MediaRef` and compose with FileStorage.
Favorites, tags, ratings. Attach via `EntityRef` and `StoryEntityTypes` at the host.

sections.title: Layering map
rows: POCOs, builders, `StoryPlayEngine`, `IStoryStore` (`netstandard2.0;net10.0`). Text MIME defaults use `MimeTypeInfo`.
Req/Res pairs and route constants. No `StoryQuery`.
Typed HTTP client for graph and play. Query stays on `IApiClient`.
Blazor story builder: library, computed graph, editors, and play. The host registers `IStoryClient`.
